reason: The winch seems useful for pulling the power pallet out of the dust, directly addressing the goal.
expectation: I expect the winch to free or partly uncover the pallet, though it may need an attachment first.

alternatives.reason: The service tool might open the shipping frame, but freeing the buried pallet seems like the more immediate task.

effect: The array is recovered, but its transport brackets need broader feet for the loose ground before it can reliably power the cabin.
reaction: The explanation of why the brackets would sink makes salvaging the frame feel purposeful.
reason: The service tool and shipping frame are the only available combination, and the result suggests the frame can provide material for the array's feet.
expectation: I expect to salvage broad sheet or straight lengths from the frame, though they may need further work before becoming feet.

effect: The frame has become cut stock, some of which can make the array's feet; other pieces have a later workshop use.
reaction: The distinction between the mounting feet and later formed parts makes me curious about what else the stock will become.
reason: The only available combination fits the stock to the recovered array, which should help support it on the loose ground.
expectation: I expect the array to gain broad mounting feet, though it may still need to be connected to the cabin.

effect: The array is now standing, so connecting it to the cabin is the next apparent step.
reaction: The mounting worked as expected; nothing else notable was revealed.
reason: The power lead and standing array are the only offered combination, and connecting them seems necessary to power the cabin.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin, though another step may be needed to supply power.

effect: The lead completed the solar power rack and restored power to the cabin, completing the chapter.
reaction: The fan returning to its ordinary note was a satisfying sign that the work mattered.

mostWorthwhile.text: Salvaging the shipping frame for mounting feet was most worthwhile: the explanation connected the wide feet to keeping the array from sinking into loose ground.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power lead was predictable and offered no other gameplay choice, though it provided a satisfying conclusion.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the shipping frame could supply both mounting feet and stock for later workshop use.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each had a clear role in recovering, supporting, or connecting the array.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the remaining metal stock becomes and how the expedition develops, although I hope for more meaningful choices.
